record.field: Sent to the customer with the serial numbers when an eBook delivery is done

div.style: font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #333; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.6;
background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%); padding: 25px; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; text-align: center;

div.p: Thank you for your purchase! Your eBook serial number(s) are listed below and attached as a PDF to this email.

div.style: background-color: #f5f6ff; border: 1px solid #d9dcf5; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 16px 0; border-radius: 4px;
background-color: #fff3cd; border-left: 4px solid #ffc107; padding: 15px; margin: 20px 0; border-radius: 4px;
div.p: Important: each serial number can only be used once. Please keep it safe and do not share it with others.
If you have any trouble activating your eBook, simply reply to this email and we'll be happy to help.

div.style: padding: 15px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: #888; background: #f9f9f9; border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;
